content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?RSVP Magazine's PostRSVP Magazine Verified accountApril 14 at 9:44 AM · Shared with PublicIrish music has suffered a loss after the death of Clannad lead singer Moya Brennan The 73-year-old passed away peacefully in Donegal, surrounded by her family.Considered the First Lady of Celtic music, Moya was known for her incredible voice and her harp playing.With Clannad, she won Grammys, BAFTAs and an Ivor Novello Award, and she also won an Emmy for an Irish music documentary.Moya remained deeply connected to her Donegal roots; despite all her success, she often organised open mic nights in the family pub, Teach Leo, in west Donegal, where new artists and established acts were always welcome.She was diagnosed with pulmonary fibrosis in recent years and passed away peacefully yesterday after a short illness.Moya is survived by her husband, Tim Jarvis, and her two children, Aisling and Paul.+6All reactions:64435 comments21 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant AuthorRSVP MagazineVerified account Full story: https://www.rsvplive.ie/.../lead-singer-clannad-moya...RSVPLIVE.IELead singer of Clannad Moya Brennan has died aged 73Lead singer of Clannad Moya Brennan has died aged 731wRobert Patrick DonovanVery saddened to hear the news of Moyà’s passing earlier today. The Brennan family ladies were gifted with the purest of crystal clear voices, with haunting melodic tones, and Moyà was no exception. I was at the launch of one of her albums ‘Harps and Voices’ a number of years back in Whelans of Wexford Street in Dublin. A long time friend of mine played the harp in her backing ensemble, and because of him I was invited. It was incredibly memorable, she sang so many of the album numbers and she was captivating. Her legendary voice and beautiful personality will be sorely missed. May she rest in eternal paradise.1w7Julie BenjellounReading that Moya died from Pulmonary Fibrosis touched my heart.. I cared for my lovely dad who passed from this awful condition.. I know how she must have suffered.. Bless her.. She was way too young.Sending love to Enya her family and friends during this difficult time.RIP Moya and thank you for the Music.1w5Jean CallaghanShe sung like an angel here on earth now she will sing with the rest of the angels in heaven.God Bless1w2Tim SumnerSuch sad news. Moya was such a nice lady the couple of times I met her. She will always be remembered and loved by so many. RIP Legend.
